text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-cha~n.
I brought a little juicy info for ya~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't your body feel heavy lately?
We've both had race after race with no time to rest."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"At times like that, it's Healing Eye Mask time~!
It monitors your fatigue through breathing and adjusts its temperature.
Helping you get a good night's rest at the perfect warmth♪"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Well? Doesn't it look good?
If we split the bill, the price is pretty cute too. Right?

Transcend seems to have accumulated quite a lot of fatigue
from running consecutive races.
It might be best to reconsider her upcoming schedule.
